level_3_missing_gates: paired barrier-region vs nonbarrier-region intervention stratification — L2 barrier registry was not calibrated on CALIBRATION for this campaign, so L5 was not stratified. The registry_digest is recorded in the lock; the calibration step never ran. Reconciliation §3 forbids adding barrier labels post-hoc.

paired-batch resampling confidence bound — the L3 calibration lock declares confidence_method='paired-batch resampling; report mean + range'. Only per-intervention summary statistics (min / median / max of loss) were persisted for interventions; per-batch intervention losses were not saved, so paired ΔL_c per batch is not reconstructable and the declared resampling cannot be executed from the persisted raw evidence. Reconciliation §3 forbids re-running to backfill.
level_3_gate_present: locked null region [-0.01, +0.01] in nat units, recorded in docs/latent_bypass/L3_CALIBRATION_LOCK.json under statistical_plan.null_region.
narrowed_causal_statement: The learned shared Recursion broadcast is causally necessary for the achieved held-out performance of the fixed 7M P2 checkpoint, and a same-norm irrelevant replacement (NORM_MATCHED_IRRELEVANT_STATE) does not preserve that performance.
does_not_claim: hidden-state bypass from this result alone
net efficiency (no cost-adjusted matched-control experiment was executed)
ACIS performance benefit — OBSERVE overhead target failed, BUCKET showed no demonstrated benefit, CONVEYOR remains refused

required_controls_before_interpretation: semantic-distance shuffle (permute across the entire test corpus rather than within a single batch)
temporal-shuffle (permute across boundaries within the same batch instead of across batch elements)
covariance-matched shuffle (draw permutations that preserve the empirical covariance of the broadcast rather than only the batchwise identity swap)
cross-seed replication (single seed cannot rule out a lucky permutation)

tested_scale.explicit_note: This checkpoint is the bounded research proxy, NOT the 350M primary model. Every quantitative conclusion here is scoped to the 7M proxy.

prior_reported_level_at_commit_739daf6.why_now_downgraded: The prior report treated aggregate ΔL_c > null-region as Level 3 evidence. The preregistered L3 requirements (§18) required (a) barrier-region stratification, (b) locked null region, and (c) a confidence bound from the declared method. Only (b) was present; (a) and (c) were missing. Post-hoc downgrade per reconciliation §4.
